王野虚了一下领着众人又来到墙角，把头微微探出去看见小偷正在翻墙。小偷翻过了后又开始四处张望，见没人后才向远处小跑而去。

孙叔小声的说：“石头去叫大力他们顺着这个方向追我们，小野张勇跟上。”

说完三人就朝小偷的方向追去，一直跑出去一公里，小偷钻进了一个小树林。在这时冯大力三人也追了上来。

孙叔小声的说：“按刚才的分组从三个方向包围过去，听我命令实施抓捕，所有人枪上膛。尽量抓活的，行动”。

六人三组迅速的朝三个方向包围过去，三组人就位后。王野看见一个中年男人正在跟小偷交易。

小偷：“李先生，还要拿多久呀？这一天拿一个虽然不多，迟早会出事儿的。”

李先生：“没事儿，快了我不是也得听指挥吗？放心吧答应你的一点都不会少。“

就在两人讨价还价时孙叔一声大喊：“动手。”

六人同时行动，王野和冯大力动作最快，在两人没反应过来时王野和冯大力已经分别把他们扑倒。

王野下手快准狠，直接把那位李先生的两条胳膊掰断，接着一把捏住她的下巴，已用巧劲下巴就脱臼了。

孙叔四人围上来时抓捕已经结束了。冯大力看着王野的动作说：“小野，你下手够狠的啊。”

王野也没搭理他，在李先生身上一阵摸索。没一会儿就从他腰间抽出一把手枪，在小腿上抽出一把匕首，最吓人的是从他兜里还拿出两个手雷。

王野套出一样众人就被吓一愣，直到把所有东西全掏出来，众人已经吓了一身冷汗。

王野调笑道：“怎么样，大力哥我下手还狠吗？”

冯大力结结巴巴的说：“卧槽，这老小子这么狠呀，还带着手雷，这是要打仗呀。”

王野说着话也没有放开李先生的下巴。王野晃动着李先生的下巴说：“别费劲了，我还能让你咬到呀。”

孙叔上前把李先生的领子抻了下来。王野调笑道：“孙叔你慢点再把他勒死了。”

孙叔说：“别废话了，压回去。”

张勇和冯大力一人押着一个往厂里走，王野走在前面不时的回头看看。孙叔看王野的样子就问道：“小野，怎么了，有什么问题吗？”

王野挠了挠头说：“孙叔，我看着这人眼熟呀。”

孙叔说：“眼熟？你认识他？”

王野摇摇头也不说话心想：”不对呀，要是我见过的肯定记得住呀，这人看着眼熟我又没印象。”

一边走王野一边挠头，时不时的还回头看两眼，突然王野一拍脑袋“卧槽，我不认识，原主认识呀，这踏马是自己的邻居”。

自从王野穿过来从来就没见过这人，但是院里的其他人倒是见过。听说这是一大家子。兄弟三个跟一个老爷子，三兄弟都结婚了可是都没孩子，是街里出了名的绝户。

孙叔停下脚步说：“小野，怎么了？”

Wang Yexu led everyone to the corner of the wall again. He slightly poked his head out and saw the thief climbing over the wall.After climbing over, the thief started to look around again. When he saw no one, he trotted away in the distance.

Uncle Sun said in a low voice: "Shitou will ask Dali and the others to chase us in this direction. Xiaoye and Zhang Yong will follow."

After saying that, the three of them chased in the direction of the thief. After running for a kilometer, the thief got into a small forest.At this time, Feng Dali and three others also caught up.

Uncle Sun said in a low voice: "Surround us from three directions according to the grouping just now. Follow my orders to arrest. Everyone has their guns loaded. Try to capture as many people as possible alive and take action."

Three groups of six people quickly surrounded them in three directions, and the three groups took their positions.Wang Ye saw a middle-aged man making a deal with a thief.

Thief: "Mr. Li, how long do you have to take it? Even if you take one in one day, something will happen sooner or later."

Mr. Li: "It's okay, don't I have to obey the command soon? Don't worry, I will promise you nothing less."

Just as the two were bargaining, Uncle Sun shouted: "Do it."

The six people acted at the same time. Wang Ye and Feng Dali were the fastest. Before the two of them could react, Wang Ye and Feng Dali had already knocked them down.

Wang Ye struck quickly and accurately, breaking off both of Mr. Li's arms. He then pinched her chin and dislocated it with such force.

The arrest was already over when Uncle Sun and four others surrounded him.Feng Dali looked at Wang Ye's movements and said, "Xiao Ye, you are very cruel."

Wang Ye ignored him and groped Mr. Li for a while.After a while, he pulled out a pistol from his waist, a dagger from his calf, and the most terrifying thing was that he took out two grenades from his pocket.

When Wang Ye pulled out something, everyone was startled. By the time he took out everything, everyone was already breaking out in a cold sweat.

Wang Ye joked: "How about it, Brother Dali, can I still be ruthless?"

Feng Dali stammered: "Damn it, this old boy is so ruthless, and he even carries a grenade. He is going to fight."

Wang Ye did not let go of Mr. Li's chin as he spoke.Wang Ye shook Mr. Li's chin and said, "Don't bother, I can still let you bite."

Uncle Sun stepped forward and stretched Mr. Li's collar down.Wang Ye teased: "Uncle Sun, please slow down and strangle him to death."

Uncle Sun said: "Stop talking nonsense and press back."

Zhang Yong and Feng Dali escorted each other towards the factory. Wang Ye walked in front and looked back from time to time.Uncle Sun looked at Wang Ye and asked, "Xiaoye, what's wrong? Is there any problem?"

Wang Ye scratched his head and said, "Uncle Sun, this man looks familiar to me."

Uncle Sun said: "Looks familiar? Do you know him?"

Wang Ye shook his head and said nothing, thinking: "No, if I have seen him, I will definitely remember him. This person looks familiar but I have no impression of him."

Wang Ye scratched his head while walking, and looked back from time to time. Suddenly Wang Ye slapped his head and said, "Damn, I don't know him. The original owner does. This horse is his neighbor."

Wang Yechuo has never seen this person since he came here, but other people in the courtyard have seen him.I heard that this is a big family.Three brothers and an old man. All three brothers are married but have no children. They are notoriously homeless in the street.

Uncle Sun stopped and said, "Xiaoye, what's wrong?"
